title: VoxClip TimedWord
description: One transcript item on the source presentation timeline, as stored in a .voxclip project (transcript.words). Same shape as TimedWord in doc/spec/transcription.md section 3.1; normative rules in doc/spec/editing.md section 2.2. Every field is written, with null for absent optional values. Timings are written once at import and never change. Constraints JSON Schema cannot express: end > start; items in a transcript are sorted by start (ties keep engine order); ids are unique within the transcript.

id.description: Opaque, unique within the transcript, never reused. Import assigns "w1", "w2", ... in final start order. Pause ids are derived from it ("pause-after-<id>").

text.description: Display text as transcribed, NFC, with attached punctuation ("words,"). Never empty and never starts or ends with whitespace. User corrections are stored separately in edits.corrections. unlabeledSpeech items use "…" (U+2026).

kind.description: word: transcribed speech (fillers included; filler status is derived from the current text). event: a non-speech sound the engine labelled, e.g. "(laughs)". unlabeledSpeech: audible speech in a gap that a non-verbatim engine did not transcribe. Only word items become captions.

start.description: Seconds on the source presentation timeline, after boundary refinement.

rawStart.description: Engine start after cleanWords and before tightening/refinement. null for detected items.

rawEnd.description: Engine end after cleanWords and before tightening/refinement. null for detected items.

conf.description: Engine confidence in [0, 1]; null when the engine gives none.

speaker.description: Diarization label from the engine, if any.

timing.description: Where the times came from (transcription spec TimingSource). unlabeledSpeech items use "detected".
